gen-unbounded-fs-hoover: Friendly and wide-set, Unbounded sprawls across the line with oversized lowercase. Hoover, a serif with compressed ascenders and a generous opening into the e, keeps paragraph after paragraph feeling sturdy and refined.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-public-sans: Gothic and tightly clustered, UnifrakturMaguntia towers over every word. Public Sans, a sans-serif with hefty lowercase and broad open counters, keeps text that runs for pages feeling steady and trustworthy.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-familjen-grotesk: Vintage and showy, Vast Shadow has no hairlines, only uniform stems. Familjen Grotesk, a lively sans whose lowercase stands tall and whose bowls stay unfinished on one side, loosens up the heading's solid stems.
gen-zodiak-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy stems, hairline arcs: Zodiak is all drama. Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with generous space between curve ends and stem, adds a sharp, refined counterweight, and that weight difference is the pair's real draw.
gen-zodiak-fs-familjen-grotesk: Zodiak looks dignified, its stems swinging between heavy and hairline. Familjen Grotesk, a sans-serif whose bowls stay open on one side, lacks any such pulse, and that split in temperament is the pair's best trait.
gen-zodiak-gf-lexend-giga: Zodiak arrives stately, its strokes swinging hard from heavy to fine. Lexend Giga, a sans with flat linework and wide tracking, lets each word open up, so extended text moves at a slow, measured pace.
gen-zodiak-gf-orbit: Sharp edges, weighty stems, razor-thin arcs: that is Zodiak. Orbit, a sans-serif with curves that stop short and letters floating apart, gives the heading a rope-like, pulse-free partner to push against.
